title: Logical Expressions
description: JSON Schema for logical expressions, comparisons, operands, and subjects used for quantitative evaluation.

logicalExpression.description: A logical expression is a verifiable statement composed of one or more comparisons or other expressions.

id.description: Unique identifier for this logical expression.

name.description: Optional short label or title for this expression.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this logical expression represents.

conjunction.description: How to combine the referenced clauses: AND = all must be true, OR = any must be true.

comparisonIds.description: List of comparison identifiers that belong to this logical expression.

expressionIds.description: List of subordinate logical expression identifiers combined under this one.

comparison.description: A single verifiable comparison statement (e.g., speed >= 120 mph).

id.description: Unique identifier for this comparison statement.

subject.description: Reference to a subject representing the measurable attribute or data item being compared.

operator.description: The operator defining how to compare the subject to the target value.

target.description: The right-hand operand — a value or set of values with optional unit.

operand.description: A value or array of values, with an optional unit, used as a comparison target.

oneOf.description: Array of permissible values (for IN or NOT IN operators).

operandValue.description: Primitive value used in a comparison.

subject.description: Defines a measurable attribute or data item that can be compared.

name.description: Name of the subject (e.g., parameter or metric name).

description.description: Detailed description of what the subject represents.
